actions.title: Approve the Registry Atlas DESIGN.md as the source-observed design contract?
actions.reason: The mandatory Google-format repair documents existing CSS values and observed UI behavior without changing the application. DESIGN.md now passes Google lint with zero errors/warnings and the project semantic audit. The design-document standard separately requires an explicit project-specific review decision; accepting here records feedback and still requires source-linked rendered evidence before compliance can be claimed.
